universe.definition: Point-in-Time historical A-share universe constructed from stock_master; historically delisted securities retained.

return.network_return_definition: log(adjusted_close_t / adjusted_close_t-1), defined only for consecutive market dates with both observations tradable/open.

rolling_design.stock_eligibility_definition: At window end t, stock i must belong to the PIT research universe and have at least ceil(c*W) non-missing return_network observations during the W trading-day window.
rolling_design.pairwise_eligibility_definition: A stock pair must have at least ceil(pairwise_min_common_ratio * W) jointly non-missing return observations when a pairwise association is estimated.

analysis_schedule.definition: Use the last actual trading day of each calendar month as the baseline structural diagnostic date.

methodological_notes: c=0.90 is a stock-level data availability threshold, not a correlation threshold and not an edge sparsification threshold.
W=60,120,252 are all retained at this stage. Step 1 does not select the final network window.
Month-end sampling is used for structural diagnostics to control computation. It is not yet the final portfolio rebalancing frequency.
Raw Pearson, residual correlation, PCA, Same/Cross Industry and other Day 2 analyses should use the same baseline universe rules and analysis dates wherever possible.
ST and external suspension validation are not part of the current network estimation universe. They will be incorporated later when constructing the tradable Alpha universe.
Historical industry validation must be completed before formal Same/Cross Industry analysis.
